blurb: A Silk Road city of blue domes.

facts.t: Alexander the Great took the city, then called Maracanda, in 329 BC. Greek writers say that here, at a feast, he killed his friend Cleitus in a drunken rage.
Three madrasas of the 1400s and 1600s, covered in tiles, face one square. Ulugh Beg, an astronomer-king, built the first and an observatory on the hill outside town.
